title: 做了三年AI教程后，他决定自己做一款游戏
author: 陈可安
text:
《群侠传：幸存者》上架Steam一周后，制作人Nenly在评价区看到一条留言：“虽然是AI的，深度很低，可玩性一般般，但他敢免费啊。”这条评价来自一位总游戏时长18.9小时的玩家。Nenly看完后没觉得沮丧，反而有点高兴。
“因为玩家在面对普通的AI游戏Demo，是不会存在这样一系列讨论的。”他说。
Nenly是一名全职AI内容创作者。2023年，他从Stable Diffusion教程做起，一路跟着AI绘画、AI视频、ComfyUI等技术变化更新自己的内容。今年，他第一次把这些年摸索出来的东西用在了游戏上。
在此之前，他没学过游戏开发，也没有程序员的工作经验，可以说是一个“游戏开发小白”。三个月后，《群侠传：幸存者》诞生了——这是一款由Nenly单人开发的“纯血AI游戏”。
这款游戏当然还有不少问题。它的玩法和《吸血鬼幸存者》、《土豆兄弟》有着相似之处，部分玩家也会觉得它在玩法深度和难度上还有提升空间。游戏的优化也不算理想，卡顿、黑屏等问题时有发生。
但至少，它已经不是一个只停留在视频里的AI游戏Demo。而且从实际呈现来看，它有完整的角色、技能、敌人、UI和战斗系统，也已经真的被玩家拿来玩了十几个小时。更让我们感到有意思的是：一个没有游戏开发经验的人，究竟是怎么把这些东西做出来的？
《群侠传：幸存者》的steam头图——当然，也是用AI生成的
■ 组建AI团队
在成为AI博主之前，Nenly从事设计工作，业余也在做设计博主。
2021年，他在B站上传过Photoshop设计教程。后来Stable Diffusion开始流行，他的内容方向也随之改变。2023年4月，他连续发布了一批Stable Diffusion教程，从Prompt和参数设置，到模型选择、ControlNet、低显存部署，再到AI动画，内容很快从传统设计转向了AIGC。其中一套Stable Diffusion零基础课程，在B站的播放量超过1800万。
那时候的Nenly初步接触了AI工具，但当时的AI还没有如今这么好上手，以AI绘画为例，需要自己安装环境、调参数、找模型，要经过反复尝试才能得到比较满意的结果。Nenly做教程的过程，本身也是在不断试错：哪个模型适合什么风格，什么工具能解决什么问题，哪些参数值得调，什么时候应该换一种方法。这些经验后来也被他用到了游戏开发中。
到了2024年，他开始做ComfyUI内容，研究怎么用AI搭建一套工作流；2025年开始，他把注意力转向大模型、Agent和零代码开发。过程中，“开发一个AI游戏”的想法逐渐诞生了。
Nenly以前想过要做游戏。他短暂用过RPG Maker，但因为觉得制作过程太繁琐，很快就放弃了。后来游戏引擎越来越成熟，他也一直没有真正进入这个领域。但在今年，Coding Agent开始流行以后，他观察到越来越多自媒体和游戏开发者用AI做出了不少游戏案例。
那时Nenly正生病在家休息，每天玩得最多的是幸存者类和武侠主题游戏。他很快有了一些基础的点子：武侠题材中的内功、外功、心法和招式，天然就很适配幸存者类型游戏的技能和Build系统——能不能把这两个元素组合在一起？
Nenly展示的Steam游戏库
于是，他决定用AI试一试。
他的第一步是打开常用的AI助手，问：“我是一个游戏开发小白，想要制作一款游戏，我需要学习什么？“
“AI给了我一些基础的知识，”Nenly说，“然后我开始询问AI，我到底需要什么？”他告诉我，自己使用了类似“Grill-me”的Skill，让AI不断追问自己的想法，帮自己理清思路：这个游戏的核心题材是什么？玩家真正的爽点是什么？希望玩家在一局游戏里经历什么？技能应该怎样设计？
“就这么一问一答，把所有模糊的需求点全部敲定，整个游戏的轮廓，就会被很高效地勾勒出来。”他说。
等策划、玩法和需求都有了比较明确的记录，他才开始让Coding Agent真正写代码。Godot是他使用的游戏引擎，“它特别适合2D游戏，文档成熟、架构开放、Agent能高效接管。”而选出它也没让Nenly纠结太久：他无需掌握完整的游戏引擎知识，AI可以根据他的需求做连线题。
Nenly使用的游戏引擎Godot
第一版Demo很快就做出来了，当然，它离游戏成品还差得很远。角色、敌人和场景基本都是几何图形组成的占位素材——方块、圆圈——在屏幕上移动。最基本的游戏框架大概是：角色可以移动，敌人会出现，玩家可以释放技能、打怪、获得经验并升级。
试玩后，Nenly发现了一个很难用代码解释的问题：这个Demo看起来似乎已经很完整，但它并不好玩。在那时，他觉得自己做出来的东西“根本没法玩超过10分钟“。
他开始问AI：要开发出一个真正的游戏，这些地方应该怎么做？
最初的原型示意图
■ 与AI合作
“比如说UI，我之前完全不知道在游戏里怎么落实，就问AI‘如果我要你做UI，你需要我给你提供什么’。”
Nenly的AI助手告诉他，他需要给AI提供设计稿，还要把素材单独导出标好位置。他嫌麻烦，让AI写了个PS脚本，把一个包含一两百个元素的PSD交给脚本处理，所有元素就可以批量导出后再交给Agent。他只需要告诉AI每个元素是什么、应该放在哪里、承担什么功能，再让Agent负责接入游戏。
但问题又来了，如果一个UI窗口大小固定，那么换一个分辨率或者改变窗口尺寸，它就可能变形。Nenly又问AI：“游戏里的UI为什么可以自适应？”
这一次，他第一次知道了Nine Slice（九宫格切图）：一个窗口被切成九块，四个角保持不变，四条边和中间区域负责拉伸或者平铺。
他按照AI告诉自己的方法，重新准备素材，再由Agent把它做成可复用的组件。现在打开他的游戏引擎，就可以直接调用这套UI组件。
可复用UI组件
类似的过程，在三个月中发生了很多次。
“我一开始不会做的事情，AI给我找到了对应的解决路径，”他说，“但前提是我得知道自己在问什么。”
AI除了是Nenly的导师，也是他的团队成员，它们的分工逐渐清晰：前期项目架构和整体规划主要交给Fable 5、Kimi K3这样的高级模型，由它们拟定开发方案；而具体的执行则一般会交给Opus 5、GPT 5.6 Sol、GLM 5.3这样的次一级模型。此外，他还搭了一套本地运行的Hermes Agent，用来跑诸如Qwen 3.6 27B这样的本地小模型，来处理一些重复、需要反复迭代但技术门槛相对低的工作。
美术部分，Nenly主要负责“判断和筛选”，具体的生成工作交给AI。“该抓的地方抓，该放手的地方放手，这是现在和AI合作最舒服的方式。”
做UI设计时，Nenly的电脑桌面
但问题也就在这里——“AI员工”能帮他一点点把游戏做出来，但没法告诉他游戏为什么不好玩，不好玩的原因又是什么。
Nenly记得，游戏实机演示的视频发布后，有人评价道：“没什么打击感”。他当时发现，自己很难解决这个问题。
“打击感”这个概念，对一个没有游戏开发经验的人来说很复杂——它几乎没有办法直接转换成一系列具体的修改任务。Nenly说：“如果直接丢给AI，大概只会得到一句‘好的，我会增加粒子效果、音效和屏幕震动，让攻击更有反馈’。但破坏玩家体验感的细节到底是什么？”
他只好尝试着摸索着解决问题，从每个小地方入手：击退速度太生硬，就调整曲线；击退时脚下没有反馈，就增加粒子；伤害数字不应该永远垂直往上飘，而应该跟着敌人的击飞方向变化。
也是在这个过程中，Nenly才发现游戏里那些让玩家觉得“理所当然“的东西背后，往往都是开发者花费大量时间、反复调整后的结果。
“原来游戏开发者要想这么多事情，做游戏是一件这么艰难的事情。”他说。
AI Agent工作中
除了“打击感”这种细节，AI在代码上也存在局限性。Nenly发现，AI写出来的很多代码只有局部是成立的。比如他想要增加一个功能，AI就只会解决这个需求本身，不会考虑把这个功能实装进整个游戏系统后会发生什么。
早期开发时Nenly用的是一些“比较笨”的模型。后来，一个战斗状态脚本，今天加50行，明天加50行，半个月后一看，已经变成了8000行。就像现在互联网上流行的一种说法——“AI经常会写出屎山代码”。
“这是人类绝对不会犯的错，”他说，“人类加到第一个50行的时候，就会想到未来它可能会变成一个很大的东西，然后去做对应的措施。但AI不会。”
Nenly后来也找到了解决办法：可以通过规则、文件和额外的上下文约束Agent，让它按照更稳定的规范工作——但这并不能一劳永逸。他仍需要不断用AI检查已有代码，和“屎山”反复搏斗。“从完全没法跑到可以跑的跨越，就已经很让我感动了。”
Nenly称之为“屎山治理”
■ “优化火葬场”
在Nenly的想法里，游戏可以先上线，做到“能玩”，之后的问题再慢慢“修理”。但实际上，“修理”比想象中困难很多。
《群侠传：幸存者》上线三周后，Steam上好评率96%，同时在线峰值达到1548人（8月13日）。这个成绩远远超出了Nenly自己的预期。但随着玩家多起来以后，这款“纯血AI游戏”的其他问题很快暴露出来。
Nenly由此进入了新游上架后必然要面对的“优化火葬场”阶段。8月中旬，当触乐联系上他时，他仍在改Bug、做优化，一边处理新版本，一边继续测试新的AI模型。优化已经做了好几轮，“已经把我弄得有点神志不清了。”他说。
他在游戏主菜单放了一个表格收集玩家反馈，上线第一周，表格里积累了近两百条反馈，大部分是BUG报告和玩法建议。
8月23日发布的优化公告
在这时，Nenly的AI又变成了一个24小时在线的制作助理。“我不用自己一条条看评论，”他说，“每天AI拉完数据，会直接告诉我这个版本可能有什么问题，哪些已经修掉了，哪些还要继续动，我再拍板。”
这能让他能保持很高的更新频率，玩家在群里说一句话，他复制粘贴给AI，AI评估可行性，第二天这个优化成果就可能出现在新版本里。“我看到评论，看到群里玩家说的话，就直接复制粘贴到AI上，和AI说‘你评估一下，能做吗？’能做，它就会落实到我下一版更新里面。”他说。
“以前玩家提出一个诉求，制作组能听到吗？或者说，他们能以多快的时效性对玩家产生反馈？很难说。”他说。
■ AI没有让游戏开发消失
如果现在让Nenly给同样想用AI做游戏的人提一些建议，他会说，首先得想清楚自己要的到底是一个漂亮的Demo，还是想真的做出一款游戏。他把前者称为“得到一个Wow Moment”。
“如果只是前者，一个下午就够了；如果是后者，得做好跟它硬扛三个月的准备。“
他反复强调人类作为制作人的主导地位：“不要放弃你作为人的判断。AI可以批量生成，但哪个技能该留、哪个操作手感是对的，得你自己去玩，自己去感受。”
为了做这款游戏，Nenly已经两个多月没玩自己喜欢的游戏了。“金铲铲一整个新赛季我都没碰过，太心酸了。”他说。
但“做游戏”这件事本身，渐渐变成了一种新的“游戏”，而且“成瘾性很强”。他也发现自己开始像经营一个“真正的”游戏项目一样，把自己当作一个正儿八经的独立游戏制作人——只是他还不愿这么称呼自己。聊到最后，Nenly说自己现在充其量只是个刚入行三个月的“4399小游戏制作人”。
不过，Nenly始终对AI制作游戏怀着积极的态度，他甚至认为，未来不应该再有“AI游戏开发”和“传统游戏开发”的明确区分。如果有一天所有游戏开发者都开始使用AI，那么“是不是AI做的”本身就不会再成为一个值得讨论的问题。到那个时候，玩家最终还是会回到同一个问题：这个游戏好不好玩？
这可能是Nenly的这个“AI作业“真正有意思的地方，它证明的并不是“一个不会编程的人现在也能通过AI的帮助成为游戏开发者”。他更愿意把这件事情理解成：AI帮他跨过了曾经挡在“游戏制作”前面的门槛，让他第一次有机会真正走进游戏开发，然后发现这里面还有那么等待“制作人”去判断、去解决的事情。
Nenly做特效设计时的桌面
html:
《群侠传：幸存者》上架Steam一周后，制作人Nenly在评价区看到一条留言：“虽然是AI的，深度很低，可玩性一般般，但他敢免费啊。”这条评价来自一位总游戏时长18.9小时的玩家。Nenly看完后没觉得沮丧，反而有点高兴。

“因为玩家在面对普通的AI游戏Demo，是不会存在这样一系列讨论的。”他说。

Nenly是一名全职AI内容创作者。2023年，他从Stable Diffusion教程做起，一路跟着AI绘画、AI视频、ComfyUI等技术变化更新自己的内容。今年，他第一次把这些年摸索出来的东西用在了游戏上。

在此之前，他没学过游戏开发，也没有程序员的工作经验，可以说是一个“游戏开发小白”。三个月后，《群侠传：幸存者》诞生了——这是一款由Nenly单人开发的“纯血AI游戏”。

这款游戏当然还有不少问题。它的玩法和《吸血鬼幸存者》、《土豆兄弟》有着相似之处，部分玩家也会觉得它在玩法深度和难度上还有提升空间。游戏的优化也不算理想，卡顿、黑屏等问题时有发生。

但至少，它已经不是一个只停留在视频里的AI游戏Demo。而且从实际呈现来看，它有完整的角色、技能、敌人、UI和战斗系统，也已经真的被玩家拿来玩了十几个小时。更让我们感到有意思的是：一个没有游戏开发经验的人，究竟是怎么把这些东西做出来的？

 

■ 组建AI团队

 

在成为AI博主之前，Nenly从事设计工作，业余也在做设计博主。

2021年，他在B站上传过Photoshop设计教程。后来Stable Diffusion开始流行，他的内容方向也随之改变。2023年4月，他连续发布了一批Stable Diffusion教程，从Prompt和参数设置，到模型选择、ControlNet、低显存部署，再到AI动画，内容很快从传统设计转向了AIGC。其中一套Stable Diffusion零基础课程，在B站的播放量超过1800万。

那时候的Nenly初步接触了AI工具，但当时的AI还没有如今这么好上手，以AI绘画为例，需要自己安装环境、调参数、找模型，要经过反复尝试才能得到比较满意的结果。Nenly做教程的过程，本身也是在不断试错：哪个模型适合什么风格，什么工具能解决什么问题，哪些参数值得调，什么时候应该换一种方法。这些经验后来也被他用到了游戏开发中。

到了2024年，他开始做ComfyUI内容，研究怎么用AI搭建一套工作流；2025年开始，他把注意力转向大模型、Agent和零代码开发。过程中，“开发一个AI游戏”的想法逐渐诞生了。

Nenly以前想过要做游戏。他短暂用过RPG Maker，但因为觉得制作过程太繁琐，很快就放弃了。后来游戏引擎越来越成熟，他也一直没有真正进入这个领域。但在今年，Coding Agent开始流行以后，他观察到越来越多自媒体和游戏开发者用AI做出了不少游戏案例。

那时Nenly正生病在家休息，每天玩得最多的是幸存者类和武侠主题游戏。他很快有了一些基础的点子：武侠题材中的内功、外功、心法和招式，天然就很适配幸存者类型游戏的技能和Build系统——能不能把这两个元素组合在一起？

于是，他决定用AI试一试。

他的第一步是打开常用的AI助手，问：“我是一个游戏开发小白，想要制作一款游戏，我需要学习什么？“

“AI给了我一些基础的知识，”Nenly说，“然后我开始询问AI，我到底需要什么？”他告诉我，自己使用了类似“Grill-me”的Skill，让AI不断追问自己的想法，帮自己理清思路：这个游戏的核心题材是什么？玩家真正的爽点是什么？希望玩家在一局游戏里经历什么？技能应该怎样设计？

“就这么一问一答，把所有模糊的需求点全部敲定，整个游戏的轮廓，就会被很高效地勾勒出来。”他说。

等策划、玩法和需求都有了比较明确的记录，他才开始让Coding Agent真正写代码。Godot是他使用的游戏引擎，“它特别适合2D游戏，文档成熟、架构开放、Agent能高效接管。”而选出它也没让Nenly纠结太久：他无需掌握完整的游戏引擎知识，AI可以根据他的需求做连线题。

第一版Demo很快就做出来了，当然，它离游戏成品还差得很远。角色、敌人和场景基本都是几何图形组成的占位素材——方块、圆圈——在屏幕上移动。最基本的游戏框架大概是：角色可以移动，敌人会出现，玩家可以释放技能、打怪、获得经验并升级。

试玩后，Nenly发现了一个很难用代码解释的问题：这个Demo看起来似乎已经很完整，但它并不好玩。在那时，他觉得自己做出来的东西“根本没法玩超过10分钟“。

他开始问AI：要开发出一个真正的游戏，这些地方应该怎么做？

 

■ 与AI合作

 

“比如说UI，我之前完全不知道在游戏里怎么落实，就问AI‘如果我要你做UI，你需要我给你提供什么’。”

Nenly的AI助手告诉他，他需要给AI提供设计稿，还要把素材单独导出标好位置。他嫌麻烦，让AI写了个PS脚本，把一个包含一两百个元素的PSD交给脚本处理，所有元素就可以批量导出后再交给Agent。他只需要告诉AI每个元素是什么、应该放在哪里、承担什么功能，再让Agent负责接入游戏。

但问题又来了，如果一个UI窗口大小固定，那么换一个分辨率或者改变窗口尺寸，它就可能变形。Nenly又问AI：“游戏里的UI为什么可以自适应？”

这一次，他第一次知道了Nine Slice（九宫格切图）：一个窗口被切成九块，四个角保持不变，四条边和中间区域负责拉伸或者平铺。

他按照AI告诉自己的方法，重新准备素材，再由Agent把它做成可复用的组件。现在打开他的游戏引擎，就可以直接调用这套UI组件。

类似的过程，在三个月中发生了很多次。

“我一开始不会做的事情，AI给我找到了对应的解决路径，”他说，“但前提是我得知道自己在问什么。”

AI除了是Nenly的导师，也是他的团队成员，它们的分工逐渐清晰：前期项目架构和整体规划主要交给Fable 5、Kimi K3这样的高级模型，由它们拟定开发方案；而具体的执行则一般会交给Opus 5、GPT 5.6 Sol、GLM 5.3这样的次一级模型。此外，他还搭了一套本地运行的Hermes Agent，用来跑诸如Qwen 3.6 27B这样的本地小模型，来处理一些重复、需要反复迭代但技术门槛相对低的工作。

美术部分，Nenly主要负责“判断和筛选”，具体的生成工作交给AI。“该抓的地方抓，该放手的地方放手，这是现在和AI合作最舒服的方式。”

但问题也就在这里——“AI员工”能帮他一点点把游戏做出来，但没法告诉他游戏为什么不好玩，不好玩的原因又是什么。

Nenly记得，游戏实机演示的视频发布后，有人评价道：“没什么打击感”。他当时发现，自己很难解决这个问题。

“打击感”这个概念，对一个没有游戏开发经验的人来说很复杂——它几乎没有办法直接转换成一系列具体的修改任务。Nenly说：“如果直接丢给AI，大概只会得到一句‘好的，我会增加粒子效果、音效和屏幕震动，让攻击更有反馈’。但破坏玩家体验感的细节到底是什么？”

他只好尝试着摸索着解决问题，从每个小地方入手：击退速度太生硬，就调整曲线；击退时脚下没有反馈，就增加粒子；伤害数字不应该永远垂直往上飘，而应该跟着敌人的击飞方向变化。

也是在这个过程中，Nenly才发现游戏里那些让玩家觉得“理所当然“的东西背后，往往都是开发者花费大量时间、反复调整后的结果。

“原来游戏开发者要想这么多事情，做游戏是一件这么艰难的事情。”他说。

除了“打击感”这种细节，AI在代码上也存在局限性。Nenly发现，AI写出来的很多代码只有局部是成立的。比如他想要增加一个功能，AI就只会解决这个需求本身，不会考虑把这个功能实装进整个游戏系统后会发生什么。

早期开发时Nenly用的是一些“比较笨”的模型。后来，一个战斗状态脚本，今天加50行，明天加50行，半个月后一看，已经变成了8000行。就像现在互联网上流行的一种说法——“AI经常会写出屎山代码”。

“这是人类绝对不会犯的错，”他说，“人类加到第一个50行的时候，就会想到未来它可能会变成一个很大的东西，然后去做对应的措施。但AI不会。”

Nenly后来也找到了解决办法：可以通过规则、文件和额外的上下文约束Agent，让它按照更稳定的规范工作——但这并不能一劳永逸。他仍需要不断用AI检查已有代码，和“屎山”反复搏斗。“从完全没法跑到可以跑的跨越，就已经很让我感动了。”

“以前玩家提出一个诉求，制作组能听到吗？或者说，他们能以多快的时效性对玩家产生反馈？很难说。”他说。

title: A Real-Life Romance (And The Love Of Fans) Fueled A Classic NES Remake
author: Heidi Kemps
text:
With headlines dominated by stories of buyouts, layoffs, employee mistreatment, and crunch, it's easy to think that game development is a constant parade of misery and strife. But the vast majority of developers still make games out of genuine love for the medium--and feel deeply connected to their teammates. The surprise announcement of a Steam remake of NES cult classic Battle of Olympus showcases the joyful side of game development: a project born of an idea that blossomed into a real-life romance, decade-long careers, and gratitude for the fans who have kept the game in peoples' minds.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W6cLmT6_oNg
The Battle of Olympus is a side-scrolling action-RPG released in 1988 by Broderbund for the NES. The visuals and gameplay take a lot of cues from Zelda II, though with a Greek mythology-inspired story and setting and a pretty solid challenge level throughout. It's been described as "a hidden gem" of the NES library many times, often overshadowed by similar titles, but beloved by those who enjoyed it.
Notably, The Battle of Olympus was developed in Japan by a very small developer named Infinity. How small? Well, the game's credits list a whopping three different people--Yukio Horimoto, Reiko Oshida, and Kazuo Sawa. Yukio and Reiko were the two main collaborators, with Yukio handling programming, Reiko on art design, and the pair working together on the game's story. As it turns out, the project would lead the two to discover their connection to each other, and they would marry soon after--making it very fitting that The Battle of Olympus's Japanese subtitle is "The Legend of Love."
Infinity would grow and continue work as a contract developer, porting titles from series like Ultima and Doom to various platforms while also releasing original work like GameCube fan-favorite Ribbit King. However, it now appears that Yukio and Reiko are ready to retire, and they want to do so by re-releasing the game that both brought them together and put Infinity on the map. But, as the YouTube video announcement emphasizes, this wouldn't have happened without the decades of support from fans of The Battle of Olympus, who continue to support the game through videos, streaming, and discussion.
It's hard not to watch the announcement video with a smile on your face, with Reiko happily describing the game's development, what it means to them, and how much fan support has touched them over such a long time. In a sea of depressing news, sometimes we need a love story to remind us why games can be so great.

Notably, The Battle of Olympus was developed in Japan by a very small developer named Infinity. How small? Well, the game's credits list a whopping three different people--Yukio Horimoto, Reiko Oshida, and Kazuo Sawa. Yukio and Reiko were the two main collaborators, with Yukio handling programming, Reiko on art design, and the pair working together on the game's story. As it turns out, the project would lead the two to discover their connection to each other, and they would marry soon after--making it very fitting that The Battle of Olympus's Japanese subtitle is "The Legend of Love."

Infinity would grow and continue work as a contract developer, porting titles from series like Ultima and Doom to various platforms while also releasing original work like GameCube fan-favorite Ribbit King. However, it now appears that Yukio and Reiko are ready to retire, and they want to do so by re-releasing the game that both brought them together and put Infinity on the map. But, as the YouTube video announcement emphasizes, this wouldn't have happened without the decades of support from fans of The Battle of Olympus, who continue to support the game through videos, streaming, and discussion.

It's hard not to watch the announcement video with a smile on your face, with Reiko happily describing the game's development, what it means to them, and how much fan support has touched them over such a long time. In a sea of depressing news, sometimes we need a love story to remind us why games can be so great.

title: Long-Delayed Prison Architect 2 Gets Exciting Update After Two Years Of Mostly Silence
author: Gabe Gurwin
text:
Prison Architect 2--a very highly anticipated sequel--was originally scheduled to launch way back in 2024. The game was delayed to September of that year before later being delayed indefinitely, but after more than two years of waiting, we finally have a sign that it could be approaching a new release date: another beta test.
Following a beta back in April--which was the first official update from Paradox on the game since it was delayed in 2024--Prison Architect 2 will hold another closed beta for September.
The sign-up sheet , which is now closed, asks a few different questions of potential testers. The most important is if they are willing to sign an NDA, so don't expect news to come out of the closed beta.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zF6Celg50vM
The actual playtest will run from September 9-15, but it's unclear if the closed beta will be followed by an open beta later down the line.
Back in August of 2024, Paradox said "we need more time to improve both the game's performance and its content," offering refunds to those who preorders and not committing to a new release date. The game hasn't been available to purchase since then, which could lead to people thinking it was canceled. Above, you can see a video of what the game looked like back then.
It's been well over a decade since the original Prison Architect released. In addition to PC, it's available on Xbox, PlayStation, and iOS. Prison Architect 2 is planned to launch for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S alongside PC.

title: CD Projekt Red Is Still Raking In The Cash As We Wait For The Witcher 4
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
CD Projekt Red has released its latest earnings report for the first half of 2026, and in short, it was a banger of a period for the company, and things are only expected to improve with many big-name releases on the horizon.
For the January-July period, CD Projekt Red generated 435 million PLN ($116.4 million USD) in revenue, which was up 23% year-over-year. Additionally, the company posted a net profit of 249 million PLN ($66.6 million USD), which was up 37% year-over-year. Total net profitability for the company was a very impressive 57%.
Management said in its report that these strong results were driven in part by "strong sales" of The Witcher and Cyberpunk games. Additionally, CD Projekt said it benefitted nicely from licensing revenue, a category that is becoming more and more important to the company.
The company specifically called out licensing deals that Cyberpunk 2077 had with games like Wuthering Waves and Apex Legends this year. Additionally, the company pointed out how well Cyberpunk TCG did on Kickstarter.
It would appear that CD Projekt's revenues are only set to grow further in the time ahead. That's because the studio has a lot of big games and content on tap, including The Witcher 3 Remastered this year , The Witcher 3's Songs of the Past expansion in 2027 , and then The Witcher 4 in 2028 .

title: PlayStation State Of Play September 2026: Start Time, How To Watch, And What To Expect
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Just when you thought there would be a post-Gamescom break for video game livestreams, Sony dropped notice that the State of Play broadcast was returning with two back-to-back broadcasts. As usual, this will be a new look at upcoming PlayStation 5 games, but beyond that, Sony has revealed only a handful of details. If you're planning to watch, here's everything you need to know about when and where you can tune in.
How to watch State of Play
https://youtu.be/JHaGFvazVA8
As usual, State of Play will be streamed live on Sony’s YouTube and Twitch channels.
YouTube
Twitch
State of Play start time
State of Play kicks off on September 3, at the following times:
6 AM PT
9 AM ET
3 PM CEST
10 PM JST
What to expect
The first State of Play broadcast will offer updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and third-party partners. The livestream will close out with an extended look at Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, and immediately after, it'll be followed by a new episode of State of Play Japan. Hosted by Yuki Kaji, State of Play Japan will be focused entirely on upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, so expect trailers and gameplay aplenty.
September alone is packed with new releases , including the PS5-exclusive Marvel's Wolverine alongside Control Resonant, NBA 2K27, The Blood of Dawnwalker , and Onimusha: Way of the Sword , so new trailers for those games wouldn't be unlikely. Looking ahead to October, there are even more high-profile releases like Hellraiser: Revival, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and Final Fantasy Resonance, just to name a few. And in November?
There's that other game you might have heard of, Grand Theft Auto 6. If State of Play is going to be a reminder that there are far too many games still to come this year and not enough hours in the day to play them, it should still be a good show overall.
What could make it even better is a closer look at other upcoming PS5 exclusives like Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet and God of War Laufey, which could be the final first-party PS5 games to have a physical edition .

title: Planet Coaster Dev Announces New Game With Disney, And That’s Very Exciting
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
Frontier Developments, the UK-based game studio known for a great many creative management sims like Planet Coaster, Zoo Tycoon, and Jurassic World Evolution, has announced a deal with Disney--and it's gotten people excited about the possibilities.
In a news release , Frontier said the game is based on "Disney's iconic portfolio of IP" and will be "fully funded" by Frontier itself. Frontier will also publish it.
Frontier CEO Jo Cooke said in a statement, “We are delighted to announce this collaboration with Disney, which further reinforces our clearly defined strategy of developing and nurturing world-class creative management simulation game franchises."
Cooke added: "Our mission with this game is to connect a passionate creative community of players with one of the world's most iconic and beloved brands, and I can’t wait to see what our talented teams will create with this amazing opportunity.”
Frontier's announcement was very light on specifics, so there is no word yet on what this game actually is. Despite that, people are buzzing with excitement over the possibilities of what Frontier could create with the Disney IP.
After all, Frontier makes some of the most-celebrated management sims out there, and Disney operates some of the biggest and best theme parks in the world. People are naturally theorizing that the new game could allow people to create their own digital Disneyland or Walt Disney World.
Disney's new CEO, Josh D'Amaro, is a big believer in video games as a new method to reach more people and has pledged to do more in gaming .
There have been Disney theme park games before. All the way back in 1990, Capcom released the NES game Adventures in the Magic Kingdom. This game allowed players to visit a virtual park based on Disney's real parks and collect keys to enter the Cinderella Castle.
There was also 2011's Kinect Disneyland Adventures, which was also made by Frontier, allowing players to explore a virtual Disneyland. Then there was 2016's city-builder Disney Magic Kingdoms for mobile, which had players seeking to restore a theme park based on Disneyland after Maleficent casts an evil spell on it. Additionally, there was 2009's Toy Story Mania, a game based on the Disney theme park ride Toy Story Midway Mania.
Disney's video game business is booming, as the company now has nine franchises that have generated more than $1 billion at retail. Gaming will be a "key part of Disney's storytelling strategy in the present and the future," the company has said.

title: PlayStation State Of Play September 2026: All The Biggest Announcements, Games, And Trailers
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Sony's September State of Play broadcasts have wrapped up, and these were a pretty chunky look at a wide variety of games. Some of the highlights included an April 2027 release date for Final Fantasy 7 Revelation , a sneak peek at the Resident Evil movie, and a stacked selection of games being developed by Asian studios.
While we didn't get to see any new trailers for upcoming PS5 games like God of War Laufey and Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, the show still had plenty of new games to show off, confirmed release dates, and more. In case you missed it, you can scroll below to check out all the trailers and announcements.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dAZRFyFQPa4
Resident Evil
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KGlapnJFacE
And we're off, not with a game reveal, but with a scene from the live-action Resident Evil movie. Austin Abrams' character, Bryan, has found himself in a seemingly deserted street in Raccoon City, but it's not long before infected members of the town are literally hurling themselves at him from rooftops--and yes, there's a LOT of blood. The film is out soon on September 18.
Marvel's Wolverine
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vyYL1WR_nZo
Ahead of its September 15 release, one more trailer for Marvel's Wolverine was revealed. The main focus here was Bolivar Trask's mutant-hunting program, which led to the creation of the infamous Sentinel robots.
Ghost of Yotei
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nlchabfwy_w
Up next was Ghost of Yotei, and fans looking to test their mettle--and their metal--can get ready for a new hardcore roguelite survival mode in single-player. You can play as several characters from Ghost of Yotei and Ghost of Tsushima's protagonist, Jin. It'll be available starting October 1.
Jin Sakai Returns In Upcoming Ghost Of Yotei Roguelike DLC
Ghost of Yotei Complete Edition: Ghosts of Sekigahara
https://youtu.be/d48IWwIRg98
A brand-new story expansion that delves into Atsu's past, Ghosts of Sekigahara offers a whole new area of Ezo to explore, new enemies, and a new weapon to master. There'll also be new armor types, new cosmetics, and more to collect when the expansion launches on October 1.
Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VMJiGh0xLhc&pp=0gcJCRoMAYcqIYzv
Monster Hunter Wilds was back in the spotlight, and its upcoming expansion looks massive. Out in 2027, Ascendance adds all-new monsters to hunt, gear to acquire, and new locations to explore.
Metro 2039
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bKY_Ks_VG9Q
The Metro games by 4A Games have always been masterclasses in crafting atmospheric dread, and it looks like Metro 2039 will continue to raise the bar for making you sweat during hostile encounters. The new gameplay on the PS5 Pro was a tense showdown between the game's protagonist and hostile forces, all set to the tune of a chirping Geiger counter. Metro 2039 launches on February 4, 2027.
Maneater 2
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JN7bn4eaoJc
We're going to need a bigger boat! Maneater is back, and in case you missed out on the first game that allowed you to unleash your inner Jaws, you can look forward to a new sequel.
Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=emymTTsBjFc
One of the biggest hits of the year, Crimson Desert's next big DLC was shown off. Charting the Unknown follows Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane as they set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. It'll be available starting October 15.
Lego PlayStation
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5FB8SIlnd6c
That rumored Lego PlayStation set is real! Based on the iconic console, the set has over 1,900 pieces, is a 1:1 replica, and has multiple diorama scenes inside it.
Final Fantasy Resonance
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IZvZYwQdXN8
There sure are a lot of games out this year with a Resonance theme in their title, aren't there? A new trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance showed off more of the HD-2D game in action, including a boss battle against Final Fantasy 7 baddie Sephiroth. I guess no single game can contain the best antagonist in video game history. A demo for Final Fantasy Resonance is also now available.
Gundam: Rogue Orbit
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XbTZpgq19ew
Gundam doesn't have the best track record when it comes to video games, but could Gundam: Rogue Orbit change all that? The new gameplay trailer for Rogue Orbit certainly looks eye-catching, as you'll pilot a giant mech against even bigger threats in this action game. The release date was also revealed, and you can expect to step into your Gundam on March 5, 2027.
And here's a closer look at the gameplay:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AiPllyLIvSo
Hunter's Moon
https://youtu.be/bKMaeHoJY2A
And now for something completely new! Hunter's Moon is a first-person historical folk-horror game, coming to PS5 on October 26.
Uncanyon
https://youtu.be/oSLtfQ-HqLM
Another interesting indie on the horizon, players will explore fantastical lands and mysterious, puzzle-filled ruins in Uncanyon.
Keeper
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PilyJu1DDEo
Now that it's no longer one of Xbox's first-party studios, it looks like Double Fine is bringing more of its games to PlayStation. First up is Keeper, its charming adventure starring a sentient, mobile lighthouse on a mission of discovery. It's available starting today for PS5.
Rev. Noir
https://youtu.be/7feaOQVG5aE
It wouldn't be a State of Play without an action-packed anime-inspired game, and Rev. Noir looks like it fits that bill. This RPG from Konami follows a young boy named Asch on a journey to stop the lightfall, a catastrophe that kills all it touches.
And here's a story trailer.
https://youtu.be/PXmX1PXvDtA
Rhapsody in Scarlet
https://youtu.be/DnMPeZDKiNk
Another new game from Konami is Rhapsody in Scarlet, a jazzy adventure set in 1920s New York. As the young magus Ellie Myers, it's up to you to stop a threat that endangers the entire world--and we're not talking about the proliferation of horrible jazz music.
"The Mafia has magic?" might just be one of the funniest lines of 2026. It was uttered in the story trailer for Rhapsody in Scarlet, and you can check it out below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FX6kr_DoXK8
PlayStation Plus updates
Mycopunk will be added to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog for Extra and Premium subscribers. The PlayStation Classics library is also being updated over the next couple of months, as Mega Man X Command Mission, Dino Crisis 2, and Ratchet and Clank will be added to it.
More PlayStation Plus Games Revealed, Including A Day-One Release
Saros: Zenith
https://youtu.be/PpM1KUTh43o
Looking for an extra challenge in Housemarque's Saros? The Zenith update is the next big free content update, and it adds the new Overlord Rush mode, Eclipse Layers, New Game+ mode, more progression options, new Carocosan modifiers, and new accessibility features.
Gran Turismo: Spec IV
https://youtu.be/qxFIHS2KhbM
The Spec IV update will launch in two parts later this year, and it'll add new circuits, new cars, Family Mode, and more to the game. The first part is out in October, and the second follows in December.
Until Dawn 2
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GA0n6t-iLBw
At long last, Until Dawn is getting a sequel. Until Dawn 2 features a ghost-hunting crew on the hunt for their biggest story yet, but things take a dark turn when their chase leads them to Akishima Island, a remote paradise abandoned for decades and hiding deadly secrets.
Grand Theft Auto 6 limited-edition DualSense controllers are on the way
https://youtu.be/rcx6I2A0TyM
And they look alright! You can choose between a white or a black DualSense controller, and each one features a shimmering, iridescent finish, textured palm-leaf details, and official GTA 6 branding. Preorders start September 10, and the controllers will start shipping out on November 19.
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LRA759MHPJs
The Unknown Journey of the Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy is coming to an end, as Final Fantasy 7 Revelation officially launches on April 8, 2027. Square Enix also showed off more gameplay, including travel from inside Cid's airship, the Highwind, a closer look at the FITS system, and how you can switch between gameplay styles.
Not enough Final Fantasy 7 Revelation for you? Then feast your eyes on the gameplay preview, which features an extended look at Yuffie's homeland of Wutai:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zv95DLDDyS8
FFVII Revelation DLC Feature Sephiroth And Vincent, Extending The Story Into 2028
Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n75P3UzZzX4
And now for the second State of Play broadcast! All about games from Japan and Asia, things kicked off with a new trailer for Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3. The game will feature more than 130 characters, including non-playable characters, from whom you can learn skills to build the ultimate warrior.
Fate/Extra Record
https://youtu.be/nr5-XGIkbg4
I'm not going to pretend that the naming convention for the Fate series games makes any sense, but they continue to look like fun RPGs. This is a remake of the first Fates game, which originally debuted in 2010, and it includes an expanded scenario, completely overhauled character graphics, and a highly strategic, deck-building, dramatic command battle system, all on top of enhanced visuals. It's out on January 28, 2027.
Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
https://youtu.be/_9nrXc0-vm8
Need a Pokemon-like game on PS5? Then check out the next entry in the Dragon Quest series, as you'll get to take control of Monster Wranglers as they embark on an adventure through a mysterious world alongside their newly acquired monsters.
The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes
https://youtu.be/c9V5ugavBQU
The Eminence in Shadow is one of the weirder Isekai anime out there, but for the fans of this edgy show that follows a reincarnated man playing a secret mastermind in a fantasy-inspired world, you can look forward to a new game based on it. Billed as a roguelite action game, it'll be out in 2027.
Rematch Season 5: Blue Lock
https://youtu.be/MLDGArmX0Tw
One of the best soccer games that you can play today, Rematch, is teaming up with the hit sports anime series Blue Lock. This should be one to keep an eye out for, if you're a fan of the beautiful game and anime.
Where the Seeds Fall
https://youtu.be/zdDJlYAVe-c
You're probably going to want to avoid this game if you have a fear of heights! Where the Seeds Fall follows a soldier who goes against orders and adopts a cursed child, and together, the two descend the World Tree as they uncover the truth of the world--one leap of faith at a time.
WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority
https://youtu.be/fIFA-lY_f6o
For some fresh horror vibes, check out the trailer for WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority. Become a Containment Agent, encounter supernatural phenomena, and try to escape the containment zone in one piece as you work to protect humanity from the threats within.
Stupid Never Dies
https://youtu.be/k_33MQFuVEY
Stupid Never Dies--which sounds like a description of my disastrous skateboarding phase that I somehow survived--got a new trailer during State of Play. An action-RPG about the weakest zombie growing ridiculously powerful, the underdog adventure launches on October 21.
SlashZero
https://youtu.be/nrJuL3XSLTc
SlashZero is a side-scrolling roguelike game with a roster of unique playable characters and deep buildcrafting. A time-limited demo for it is now available.
Digimon: Time Stranger - A Hero's Eternal Legacy expansion
https://youtu.be/8v_Mg3yAnSY
Digimon: Time Stranger was one of our favorite games of last year, and we're pretty chuffed to see that more content is on the way for it. Set three years after the events of the game, A Hero's Eternal Legacy is a new expansion that launches in 2027.
Crown of No Quarter
https://youtu.be/OqViikdsc7Y
The debut trailer for Crown of No Quarter teased a world of endless battle for warriors from across the ages. You'll need to gather your forces, sail the seas, and invade strongholds in this game.
Daba: Land of Water Scar
https://youtu.be/YBTN74SHUnk
With the world dying of thirst--literally--it's up to the awakened Clayman to cross ruined snowfields and desolate deserts to reforge a divine soul and bring salvation to the world. The trailer didn't reveal too much, but Daba looks like a rock-solid action game from Sony's China Hero Project initiative.

The new gameplay on the PS5 Pro was a tense showdown between the game's protagonist and hostile forces, all set to the tune of a chirping Geiger counter. Metro 2039 launches on February 4, 2027.

Maneater 2

We're going to need a bigger boat! Maneater is back, and in case you missed out on the first game that allowed you to unleash your inner Jaws, you can look forward to a new sequel.

Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown

One of the biggest hits of the year, Crimson Desert's next big DLC was shown off. Charting the Unknown follows Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane as they set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. It'll be available starting October 15.

Lego PlayStation

That rumored Lego PlayStation set is real! Based on the iconic console, the set has over 1,900 pieces, is a 1:1 replica, and has multiple diorama scenes inside it.

Final Fantasy Resonance

There sure are a lot of games out this year with a Resonance theme in their title, aren't there? A new trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance showed off more of the HD-2D game in action, including a boss battle against Final Fantasy 7 baddie Sephiroth. I guess no single game can contain the best antagonist in video game history. A demo for Final Fantasy Resonance is also now available.

Gundam: Rogue Orbit

Gundam doesn't have the best track record when it comes to video games, but could Gundam: Rogue Orbit change all that? The new gameplay trailer for Rogue Orbit certainly looks eye-catching, as you'll pilot a giant mech against even bigger threats in this action game. The release date was also revealed, and you can expect to step into your Gundam on March 5, 2027.

And here's a closer look at the gameplay:

Hunter's Moon

And now for something completely new! Hunter's Moon is a first-person historical folk-horror game, coming to PS5 on October 26.

Uncanyon

Another interesting indie on the horizon, players will explore fantastical lands and mysterious, puzzle-filled ruins in Uncanyon.

Keeper

Now that it's no longer one of Xbox's first-party studios, it looks like Double Fine is bringing more of its games to PlayStation. First up is Keeper, its charming adventure starring a sentient, mobile lighthouse on a mission of discovery. It's available starting today for PS5.

Rev. Noir

It wouldn't be a State of Play without an action-packed anime-inspired game, and Rev. Noir looks like it fits that bill. This RPG from Konami follows a young boy named Asch on a journey to stop the lightfall, a catastrophe that kills all it touches.

And here's a story trailer.

Rhapsody in Scarlet

Another new game from Konami is Rhapsody in Scarlet, a jazzy adventure set in 1920s New York. As the young magus Ellie Myers, it's up to you to stop a threat that endangers the entire world--and we're not talking about the proliferation of horrible jazz music.

"The Mafia has magic?" might just be one of the funniest lines of 2026. It was uttered in the story trailer for Rhapsody in Scarlet, and you can check it out below:

PlayStation Plus updates

Mycopunk will be added to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog for Extra and Premium subscribers. The PlayStation Classics library is also being updated over the next couple of months, as Mega Man X Command Mission, Dino Crisis 2, and Ratchet and Clank will be added to it.

More PlayStation Plus Games Revealed, Including A Day-One Release

Saros: Zenith

Looking for an extra challenge in Housemarque's Saros? The Zenith update is the next big free content update, and it adds the new Overlord Rush mode, Eclipse Layers, New Game+ mode, more progression options, new Carocosan modifiers, and new accessibility features.

Gran Turismo: Spec IV

The Spec IV update will launch in two parts later this year, and it'll add new circuits, new cars, Family Mode, and more to the game. The first part is out in October, and the second follows in December.

Until Dawn 2

At long last, Until Dawn is getting a sequel. Until Dawn 2 features a ghost-hunting crew on the hunt for their biggest story yet, but things take a dark turn when their chase leads them to Akishima Island, a remote paradise abandoned for decades and hiding deadly secrets.

Grand Theft Auto 6 limited-edition DualSense controllers are on the way

And they look alright! You can choose between a white or a black DualSense controller, and each one features a shimmering, iridescent finish, textured palm-leaf details, and official GTA 6 branding. Preorders start September 10, and the controllers will start shipping out on November 19.

Final Fantasy 7 Revelation

The Unknown Journey of the Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy is coming to an end, as Final Fantasy 7 Revelation officially launches on April 8, 2027. Square Enix also showed off more gameplay, including travel from inside Cid's airship, the Highwind, a closer look at the FITS system, and how you can switch between gameplay styles.

Not enough Final Fantasy 7 Revelation for you? Then feast your eyes on the gameplay preview, which features an extended look at Yuffie's homeland of Wutai:

FFVII Revelation DLC Feature Sephiroth And Vincent, Extending The Story Into 2028

Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3

And now for the second State of Play broadcast! All about games from Japan and Asia, things kicked off with a new trailer for Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3. The game will feature more than 130 characters, including non-playable characters, from whom you can learn skills to build the ultimate warrior.

Fate/Extra Record

I'm not going to pretend that the naming convention for the Fate series games makes any sense, but they continue to look like fun RPGs. This is a remake of the first Fates game, which originally debuted in 2010, and it includes an expanded scenario, completely overhauled character graphics, and a highly strategic, deck-building, dramatic command battle system, all on top of enhanced visuals. It's out on January 28, 2027.

Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World

Need a Pokemon-like game on PS5? Then check out the next entry in the Dragon Quest series, as you'll get to take control of Monster Wranglers as they embark on an adventure through a mysterious world alongside their newly acquired monsters.

The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes

The Eminence in Shadow is one of the weirder Isekai anime out there, but for the fans of this edgy show that follows a reincarnated man playing a secret mastermind in a fantasy-inspired world, you can look forward to a new game based on it. Billed as a roguelite action game, it'll be out in 2027.

Rematch Season 5: Blue Lock

One of the best soccer games that you can play today, Rematch, is teaming up with the hit sports anime series Blue Lock. This should be one to keep an eye out for, if you're a fan of the beautiful game and anime.

Where the Seeds Fall

You're probably going to want to avoid this game if you have a fear of heights! Where the Seeds Fall follows a soldier who goes against orders and adopts a cursed child, and together, the two descend the World Tree as they uncover the truth of the world--one leap of faith at a time.

WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority

For some fresh horror vibes, check out the trailer for WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority. Become a Containment Agent, encounter supernatural phenomena, and try to escape the containment zone in one piece as you work to protect humanity from the threats within.

Stupid Never Dies

Stupid Never Dies--which sounds like a description of my disastrous skateboarding phase that I somehow survived--got a new trailer during State of Play. An action-RPG about the weakest zombie growing ridiculously powerful, the underdog adventure launches on October 21.

SlashZero

SlashZero is a side-scrolling roguelike game with a roster of unique playable characters and deep buildcrafting. A time-limited demo for it is now available.

Digimon: Time Stranger - A Hero's Eternal Legacy expansion

Digimon: Time Stranger was one of our favorite games of last year, and we're pretty chuffed to see that more content is on the way for it. Set three years after the events of the game, A Hero's Eternal Legacy is a new expansion that launches in 2027.

Crown of No Quarter

The debut trailer for Crown of No Quarter teased a world of endless battle for warriors from across the ages. You'll need to gather your forces, sail the seas, and invade strongholds in this game.

Daba: Land of Water Scar

With the world dying of thirst--literally--it's up to the awakened Clayman to cross ruined snowfields and desolate deserts to reforge a divine soul and bring salvation to the world. The trailer didn't reveal too much, but Daba looks like a rock-solid action game from Sony's China Hero Project initiative.

title: MMOs Have “Stagnated,” Guild Wars 3 Studio Head Says
author: Cameron Koch
text:
Guild Wars 3 developer ArenaNet wants to try "wild, crazy ideas" in a genre that, according to its studio head, has "stagnated" in recent years.
During a hands-off demo where early Guild Wars 3 gameplay was shown to members of the press, I asked ArenaNet studio head Colin Johanson about the state of the MMO genre in 2026 and what problems Guild Wars 3 is looking to solve.
He had plenty to say on the subject. Many MMO players are still playing the same games they were 10-20 years ago, Johanson said, citing decade-old (or older) examples like World of Warcraft, The Elder Scrolls Online, Final Fantasy 14, and, of course, ArenaNet's own Guild Wars 2. In that same time, "minute-to-minute gameplay in MMOs has stagnated," even as other genres have modernized and become more approachable, he said.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ITPzxITngqA
That's "really good timing" for ArenaNet and Guild Wars 3, Johanson said, and one that presents a big opportunity for a new game to break in and shake up the scene.
"There's been very little new in the last decade, and a lot of those [newer] games either don't exist anymore or were canceled in development before they made their way out," Johanson said. "We see MMO fans constantly clamoring for and asking for something new and saying this genre desperately needs something new to move it forward right now."
Johanson certainly has a point. The biggest new MMOs of the last few years have been games like 2021's New World or Korean MMOs like Lost Ark and Throne and Liberty , all originally tied to Amazon's game publishing arm. If nothing else, their launches showed how hungry MMO players are for a big new game in the space, with each title attracting hundreds of thousands of concurrent players in their first weeks, or in the case of Lost Ark, over 1.3 million .
Flash forward to now, and Amazon is pulling out of the MMO business entirely and shutting New World down . Other prospective MMOs fans were eager to learn more about have also languished. Riot's planned League of Legends MMO went back to the drawing board in 2024 after years of development, even as the former executive producer of that project's next new MMO also got canceled . ESO is being scaled back amidst layoffs, with a sci-fi MMO codenamed Project Blackbird from the same studio getting canceled before ever being officially announced. Another promising MMO that raised $3 million onKickstarter, Ashes of Creation, imploded earlier this year following the resignation of its game director and an ongoing legal battle.
It's a grim state of affairs for MMO fans, but Johanson said there is an opportunity to make a MMO that looks to solve the genre's approachability problem and overcome the perception they are "second jobs" many players don't have time for. For him, that means making a game where meaningful progress can be made in shorter play sessions, you can play with a controller, and prep time is massively cut down.
"For many gamers today, where we have so many different games to pick from and our time is more challenged than ever in how much time we have to play any individual game, if you don't have a couple of hours available, you're just not going to play an MMO and you're going to play other genres that are more approachable and can be played in quicker sessions," Johanson said.
He said it also means designing a MMO where it's okay to have a "healthy relationship" with the game, one where players can take breaks between expansions and not feel like they've been completely left behind. Being more approachable is about more than just attracting a wider audience, he said. It's also about making it more approachable for MMO fans who have busy real-life schedules and more game options than ever before.
"You can set this game down and go play a bunch of other games and come back when the next expansion comes out and that's okay," Johanson said. "That's a totally healthy relationship to have with a game, and we don't need to demand that you be in this game 24/7 to stay relevant and to stay up with everybody else."
Johanson's comments line up with a blog post he penned shortly after Guild Wars 3 was announced. In it, he said the goal is to make a game that respects players' time and investment and can be enjoyed by those who only have a few hours a week to play. In that same blog, Johanson said Guild Wars 3 won't have a subscription fee , nor what he described as "hidden" subscriptions like battle passes.
Guild Wars 3 doesn't currently have a release date but will release for PC and PlayStation 5. A beta is slated to begin Fall 2027.

title: Resident Evil Trailer Shows The Sequence Where Its Star Almost Died For Real
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
During the September 3 State of Play , Sony debuted a new clip from the upcoming Resident Evil movie, and it was both dark and hilarious. That should be no surprise, as comedy and horror are naturally intertwined, and the movie is written and directed by sketch comedy veteran Zach Cregger.
In the clip, we see Austin Abrams' character, the medical courier Bryan, running down a street in Raccoon City as zombies throw themselves off rooftops trying to catch him. They explode on impact, with blood flying everywhere.
Bryan screams as he runs down the street amidst the carnage, uttering some hilarious noises and guttural screams. Check out the new footage below.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KGlapnJFacE
Cregger wanted to film this sequence practically instead of using CGI. The production team created 150-pound “body-sized blood bags” that were dropped from cranes to create the effect. One of the blood bags came close to striking Abrams, and Cregger said, “It would’ve killed him.”
Bryan, according to Cregger, is an "idiot" who finds himself in a horrifying situation and is just trying to survive.
The entire movie feels like “one gigantic sequence,” Cregger said, adding that things begin to “pop off” five minutes into the movie–and it only ramps up from there.
“It feels like one gigantic sequence,” he says. “Things pop off about five minutes in and it basically stays like that until the end. What I love about the games is that you move from set-piece to set-piece. Every location has a unique challenge. So again, I’m borrowing from the games directly in that rhythm, where you’re just running through a gauntlet.”
The Resident Evil movie releases on September 18, and it's expected to have the biggest opening ever for a Resident Evil movie .

title: Jin Sakai Returns In Upcoming Ghost Of Yotei Roguelike DLC
author: Jason Fanelli
text:
Today, during the PlayStation State of Play livestream , Sucker Punch offered a look at Ghost of Yotei's upcoming roguelike mode, Most Wanted. The mode will feature four playable characters, and Yotei's Atsu, Oyuki, and Nagato will be joined by a familar face from the past: The Ghost of Tsushima, Jin Sakai, will officially return.
Most Wanted, which the trailer calls a "combat survival mode," lets players choose one of the four samurai, each with their own weapons and abilities, to take them on a hunt for one of the Yotei Six. Each of the Six, if defeated, will offer a reward of coins that can then be spent to upgrade the samurai for future runs.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nlchabfwy_w
A new post on the official PlayStation Blog further explores the new mode, saying that the core of the mode lies in its Perks system. "As you progress through a run, you’ll frequently select between new perks including weapon mastery, gear loadouts, summons, parries, survivability, and more," the blog says. "These are the cornerstone of crafting the perfect build and lead to some of the most exciting surprises as you find the challenge or unexpected value that comes from mixing and matching perks.
This new mode marks the first time Jin Sakai returns as a playable characters since his starring role in 2020's Ghost of Tsushima. The PS Blog post says that the development team made sure to "take his Ghost of Tsushima model and keep it faithful while also applying upgrades for Ghost of Yōtei," as he can use all four of his fighting stances from Ghost of Tsushima, as well as sticky bombs, the Dance of Wrath, and his Ghost stance.
Ghost of Yotei's Echoes of Sekigahara expansion, as well as the Most Wanted roguelike mode, launch October 1. Players who own the base game can purchase a Complete Edition upgrade with the extra content, while new players can purchase Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition with all content in one package.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation And Its PS1-Style World Map Arrive In April
author: Jason Fanelli
text:
Final Fantasy VII Revelation finally has a release date: April 8, 2027. Square Enix confirmed the news today during the PlayStation State of Play livestream , along with nearly 10 minutes of new footage.
The release date was confirmed via a trailer highlights all eight playable characters in the main party: Cloud, Tifa, Barret, Red XIII, Yuffie, Cait Sith, Vincent, and Cid. We also see gameplay of the team in action, including team-up abilities like Vincent's Galian Beast form rushing a group of enemies with Red XIII, and Tifa and Yuffie attacking from above with a dive kick/spinning shuriken combo.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8YHP48v7vyg
From there, FF7 director Naoki Hamaguchi introduced an extended look at raw gameplay, which focused on traveling the massive world map. Invoking the original game's PlayStation 1 roots, the Highwind flies over the world of Gaia, and players can pilot it wherever they wish. Once they reach a location of interest, they can choose a party from any of the eight playable characters, and then parachute down to the surface instantly.
The demo then dives into a side quest in Gongaga featuring Sotetsu, a character featured in a FF7 Rebirth side quest. Yuffie, knowing Sotetsu from that side quest, has a special interaction with him, implying that some missions may play out differently depending on the characters brought to complete them.
Along with the news of Final Fantasy VII Revelation's April 8 release date, the Steam page for the game dropped a few hints on what is coming after launch, with listings for story expansions featuring two key characters .

title: GTA 6 Fishing And Hunting Doesn’t Work Like You Think It Does
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
Rockstar Games has confirmed new details about how fishing and hunting work in GTA 6, and it's probably not what you would expect.
Speaking to YouTuber TGG , Rockstar North's Rob Nelson confirmed that fishing in GTA 6 is limited to catch and release--players cannot keep any fish. Why? "It didn't fit this game," Nelson said, adding that fishing in GTA 6 is mainly for fun. Players can also complete fishing-related challenges and amass collectibles.
Jason fishing in GTA 6.
In Rockstar's last game, 2018's Red Dead Redemption II, players could catch a great assortment of fish and then cook and eat them. That made sense given the time period of the game, that being 1899. GTA 6 is set in modern times, and main characters Jason and Lucia, like you and me, have access to numerous food options at any given time. Eating food in GTA 6 will make you gain weight, and players can use the excess calories to bulk up at the gym.
As for hunting in GTA 6, Nelson said the game's hunting system is one of many ways in the game that players can make money . The hunting system is unlocked through a friend that knows Jason, but TGG theorized that this person has not been shown yet in any GTA 6 footage so far.
In addition to catching fish and killing animals, players will be able to "inspect" the creatures, borrowing a system from Red Dead Redemption 2. GTA 6 also has dogs that you can pet, scold (you monster), and inspect .
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. At the State of Play event on September 3, Sony and Rockstar announced a GTA 6-themed DualSense controller .

title: GTA 6 Limited-Edition DualSense Controllers Are On The Way, And They Look Fantastic
author: Cheri Faulkner
text:
During today's State of Play broadcast, Sony announced that two limited-edition Grand Theft Auto 6 -themed DualSense controllers will be released.
They'll come in black or white and feature distinctive Leonida-themed graphics and coloring. Both have pastel pink icons on the buttons, with a blue-purple shift that sparkles along the bottom of the controller.
You can get the controller in black or white.
On the rear of the controllers, the Grand Theft Auto logo is embossed, while the grips maintain the standard PlayStation icon texture.
Elsewhere, the GTA 6 logo is etched on to the touchpad, and palm-tree-like shapes are embossed on the controller grips.
Both controls launch alongside GTA 6 on its release date, November 19. Surely there's no better way to experience the biggest gaming release of the decade so far? They'll set you back $85 each.
At least you'll no longer have to mash the X button on your new controller, as it's been confirmed that there's a new mechanic for sprinting in GTA 6. In other GTA 6 news, you won't have to tend to Jason and Lucia's romantic relationship if you don't want to.

title: Epic Games’ New Voice Chat Lets You Keep Talking To Friends While Playing Different Games
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Epic Games has announced that it's going to make it easier than ever to hang out and talk with friends across different platforms by launching Epic Parties. This voice chat service will work across Fortnite (on all supported platforms), the Epic Games Store launcher (PC, iOS, and Android), and the Epic Games app (iOS and Android).
For example, you can start a voice party from your phone or PC launcher, ring up a friend who is busy playing Fortnite on their PlayStation, and even transfer that call from your phone to your PC when you get back to your desk. This means that you can sit in on a voice call through the Epic PC Launcher while playing completely different games from your Epic library. Other benefits include a seamless approach to grouping friends together, as Epic says that if you're in a voice party with friends and everyone decides to open Fortnite, then the game will automatically drop you all into the same lobby together.
This new feature is competing directly with Discord, which has been the go-to third-party app for users for several years. Epic's built-in alternative aims to let users bring their social list, voice channels, and digital avatar with them across multiple platforms and from game to game, whether you are on iOS, Android, PC, or console. Epic has also hinted that these voice and avatar systems will be integrated directly into Unreal Engine 6, and the tools will be offered to other developers in time. For now, it's currently rolling out to Fortnite, and Epic Parties will be available in Rocket League next year.
According to Epic's year-in-review stats , over $1 billion was spent in the store in 2025, and it reached an all-time record of 78 million monthly active users on PC. Earlier this year, Epic spoke more about its plans to further improve its digital storefront . "Our goal is to keep building a storefront and launcher that players want to engage with and use to grow their game library, but we need to be able to connect players with the game they want to play at the time they want to play it," Kyle Billings, director of strategy and business operations at the Epic Games Store, said to GameSpot.

title: Sony And Microsoft: We’re Keeping Tariff Refunds For Ourselves And You’ll Get Nothing
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
Following Nintendo , both Sony and Microsoft have now argued in court that they are not obligated to provide refunds to consumers who paid more for a price-hiked PlayStation or Xbox console related to US President Donald Trump's controversial tariff plan. The tariffs were deemed illegal, prompting companies to seek refunds. The companies getting those refunds are largely keeping them, though there have been some exceptions and outliers.
In July, Sony said it was projecting to get $508 million back in refunds from the US government over the tariffs, and "most" of that money was owed to Sony's gaming division. Sony is facing a lawsuit that claims Sony should disperse refunds, at least in part, to consumers who paid more for a PS5.
Sony's legal team, however, says Sony will keep all the money and you'll get nothing back.
"Paying fair market price for voluntarily purchased consumer goods is not a legally cognizable injury in fact," the lawyers said in a memo seeking to dismiss the class-action suit, as reported by Game File .
Microsoft's own legal team took a similar approach, saying in court, "There is nothing unjust about plaintiff purchasing an Xbox at an advertised price and getting exactly what [they] paid for..."
Sony's argument in court added that the class-action lawsuit brought by gamers does not provide evidence that tariffs were to blame for the PS5 price hike implemented in August 2025, calling the claim "speculative and illogical." In announcing the price hike, Sony said it was raising PS5 prices in response to a "challenging economic environment," but not mentioning tariffs specifically.
Sony's legal team said things like "inflation, currency fluctuations, component costs, logistics, competitive dynamics, or demand" could have also contributed to the PS5 price hike. Indeed, beyond tariffs alone, the AI-fueled demand for components and memory--the same equipment needed to make PS5 consoles--has led to shortages and increased costs for Sony and others in the market.
No refunds.
Sony went on to cite its own additional PS5 price hike in March 2026--following the Supreme Court deeming the tariffs illegal--as proof that the hikes are not attributable to tariffs.
"If tariffs were the cause of the price increases, one would expect SIE to lower prices once the tariffs were eliminated--not raise them again. Instead, the timeline confirms that the pricing of PlayStation consoles includes a diverse and dynamic set of input costs," Sony's lawyers said.
Microsoft took a similar stance, saying the class-action suit fails to provide "pricing differential attributable to tariffs..."
For Sony, its refusal to provide tariff refunds to players is just the latest public relations issue the company is facing. The company also announced plans to end support for physical PlayStation game discs in 2028 , and a lot of people dislike that decision.
Not every gaming company is taking such a hard line on this topic. Panic, the company behind the Playdate gaming handheld, said it will pass its own refunds on to customers who paid more . People should get about $12 back.
“It’s just not our money to keep, and it felt really good to give it back,” Panic’s Cabel Sasser told  Game Developer . “That’s an easy way to know you made the right decision.”
Many companies received major tariff refunds, and they are handling refunds differently. For example, Wamart and Home Depot have said they will use the cash infusion to lower prices on a variety of products , but not directly refund anyone..
“At the end of the day, a product is worth what somebody’s willing to pay for it, and there is a lot of choice in this marketplace,” Bryan Eshelman, a managing director at consulting firm AlixPartners, told CNBC .
This may be true, and Sony may have no legal obligation to pass along refunds to consumers, but that doesn't mean it's sitting well with everyone. People are loudly voicing their opinions on social media, with many posting the Jeremy Irons quote from the movie Margin Call where his character says, "We are selling to willing buyers at the current fair market price."
The latest gaming-related price hike came from Nintendo, which increased the price of the Switch 2 from $450 to $500 on September 1. Historically, console prices came down over time, but the world is different today .

title: Everything From The State Of Play That You Can Try Right Now
author: Tomas Franzese
text:
The most exciting part of a video game showcase is when developers shadow-drop something immediately after announcing it. Today's State of Play had a few such announcements. Demos for a new Final Fantasy game and anime-inspired action titles, as well as a port of a Double Fine game that was previously Xbox exclusive, are out now.
Final Fantasy Resonance Demo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IZvZYwQdXN8&pp=0gcJCRoMAYcqIYzv
Final Fantasy Resonance is an HD-2D game based on the narrative of Brave Exvius, a game previously only available on mobile. This demo will give you a taste of the game's first chapter and all of the throwback pixel art and Final Fantasy character summons that come during that. Progression will carry over to the full game too, which is out on October 22. Although only the PS5 version was mentioned during the stream, the demo is also out now on PC, Switch, Switch 2, and Xbox Series X|S.
Keeper's PS5 Port
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PilyJu1DDEo
Keeper was released by Double Fine in October 2025 and is the latest title from Headlander and Stacking designer Lee Petty. It's a surreal, visually stunning game where you explore a decrepit world as a lighthouse and its fantastical bird companion. It flew under the radar last year, so it's great to see it come to PS5 now that Double Fine is independent once again. It got a price drop and new psychedelic mode today too.
Stupid Never Dies Demo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k_33MQFuVEY
Stupid Never Dies is a quirky new action game from Hiroyuki Kobayashi, a producer best known for his work on series like Dino Crisis and Dragon's Dogma at Capcom. You can get a taste of its flashy action from this new demo, which lasts two hours and lets you transfer progress once Stupid Never Dies launches on October 21.
SlashZero Demo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrJuL3XSLTc
SlashZero is a fast-paced action roguelike with an anime aesthetic where players control a time hacker trying to kill something called "Hieros-I." While the game won't be out until sometime next spring, a limited-time demo was released on PS5 today.

title: Double Fine Flexes Its Independence With Price Cuts And A New PS5 Release
author: Chris Compendio
text:
After its liberation from Microsoft's ownership , the newly independent Double Fine Productions has been quite busy. At the September 2026 State of Play , PlayStation revealed that Double Fine's surreal adventure Keeper is shadow-dropping on PS5, and the studio added that the acclaimed game is getting some intriguing updates.
Along with the surprise PS5 release, Keeper is also getting a "Psychedelic Mode," which is probably exactly what it sounds like. Considering how much bizarre imagery is already in the game, an even more "wild new way" to play the game should be a treat. And Double Fine wants to sweeten the deal with a price cut, which the studio implemented with its other recent title, Kiln.
https://bsky.app/profile/doublefine.com/post/3mummzhp4ws2f
Keeper launched in 2025 at a $30 price point and now sells for $20. Kiln, which released earlier in 2026, cost $20 for the base game, with a $30 deluxe "Fired Up" edition; those are now $8 and $10 , respectively. Unlike Keeper, Kiln launched on PS5 along with Xbox and Steam.
Meanwhile, Double Fine revived its Amnesia Fortnight game jam and already exceeded its crowdfunding goal of $400,000 for the project. The game jam, a tradition for Double Fine since 2007 (and was halted while it was under Xbox's ownership), will result in the studio's next title.
But the loftiest stretch goal in the crowdfunding campaign is the promise of a Brutal Legend 2 should it reach $100 million . It's a huge ask, and one that likely won't be met pending intervention from any moguls who are big Jack Black fans.
Keeper was beloved by critics, with GameSpot's Keeper review calling it a "visual feast." Since Double Fine's spin-off from Xbox, purchases of its games will directly support the studio . The split from Microsoft occurred in July, but the studio unfortunately cut 25% of its staff as a result.

title: The Witcher 4 Will Be Made “Predominantly Using People” And Not AI
author: Eddie Makuch
text:
CD Projekt joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski has commented on how the studio thinks about artificial intelligence when it comes to developing games.
Speaking during CD Projekt's latest earnings briefing, the executive said AI is "definitely becoming a thing in games development." However, he stressed that the Polish developer is still "predominantly using people" to make games.
"AI, if anything, is a tool like many others that's helping in places that can maybe become more helpful in the future but we're not planning to rely on AI making complete games," he said, as reported by PC Gamer .
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=54dabgZJ5YA&rco=1
Nowakowski said CD Projekt makes "very complex games," and using AI would not be "the right or ethical path to follow."
At the same time, Nowakowski said every studio--or at least its management--will decide for itself how it wants to use, or not use, AI.
"So whether this is true for the whole industry, I'm not the person to make those statements. I think everybody has to make those judgments on their own," he said.
The Witcher 4 is set for release in 2028 , and it kicks off a new trilogy of games. CD Projekt is also working on Cyberpunk 2 and a multiplayer Witcher game .

title: 《GTA 6》独家专访：“全方位的进步”
author: Rachel Weber
text:
听 Rockstar North 工作室联席负责人 Rob Nelson 娓娓道来
随着《GTA 6》发售日的临近，粉丝们变得越来越躁动不安，渴望挖出所有的新情报，哪怕是最微小的细节也好。而与此同时，Rockstar North 工作室联席负责人 Rob Nelson 则是早已无比熟悉个中细节，却必须一直守口如瓶。
当我出现在他位于苏格兰爱丁堡的办公室里，对他开展 IGN 独家专访时，他终于有机会倾吐一些《GTA 6》的秘密了。
Nelson 说：“我认为我们在这款游戏上面临的挑战，和以往开发任何新游戏时都是一样的。该如何在已有的优秀基础上全面拓展、进化，同时保留住历代作品打动玩家的地方？”
在很大程度上，这个问题的答案似乎是 —— 打造一个能够让玩家投入大量时间，并获得高质量体验的完整世界，让玩家享受充实的活动，而不仅仅是为了赚钱而刷支线，或者为了轻松打通主线而提升属性。作为《GTA 6》的舞台，整个雷奥奈达州会让玩家忍不住想要探索和体验。
Nelson 说：“这个游戏太庞大了，我怀疑我们团队都没有人能够完全掌握它的全貌。”
雷奥奈达交友指南
在采访期间，Nelson 一边回答我的问题，一边亲手操作，为我演示了一段《GTA 6》游戏内容，而这段演示也完美地印证了他的说法。NPC 人头攒动，街道里车水马龙，到处都有制造混乱的机会。路边行人随时有可能引发事端。
Nelson 介绍说：“在《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》里，我们极力扩展了 NPC 交互，但这一次，我们想要再进一步。开发团队为此打造了大量疯狂而有趣的对话，你完全可以站在 NPC 旁边听他们聊天，但我们也试图找到一种平衡，如果你靠得太近，他们会意识到你在偷听。
“所以，如果你一直站在那里，试图把整段对话听完，他们往往会转过身来，注意到你，然后说，‘喂，你有事儿吗？’或者如果你长时间尾随某个 NPC，而且跟得太近，让对方听到了脚步声，他们会冲着你喊‘嘿！’接下来他们可能会变得有攻击性，或者会设法甩掉你。
“在《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》里初次尝试这种概念时，我们就设想过，如果在一个人口稀疏的世界里能够行得通，那么把它放到一个现代大城市里会是什么样的感觉？这是在开发本作时，我们接下来的一个既令人害怕，但也非常值得尝试的挑战。”
据 Nelson 介绍，为了用丰富多彩的 NPC 填充这个世界，团队投入了海量的时间、科研和工作，NPC 有着极为丰富的造型，使得游戏中的每一个区域都显得独一无二。Rockstar 甚至在洛杉矶组建了一支专门负责 NPC 对话的团队，这也就是为什么你能在《GTA 6》听到“你可以拿我的蛋蛋当沙袋”或者“给钱就呲你一身尿”等等神人台词的原因。
NPC 的进化并没有止步于闲聊、穿搭或者被玩家抢走 5 美元之类的。这也是《GTA 6》明显受到《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》开发经验影响的地方之一。
Nelson 说：“这套 NPC 交互系统是从《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》继承并进化而来的。过去我们也有与 NPC 交谈的机制，《荒野大镖客：救赎 1》和《GTA 5》都有简单的交互系统，但那些交互都还比较简单。而到了《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》，我们终于能做出一套比较丰富的 NPC 交互系统。”
他特意提到了手柄左扳机的用法：左扳机以前只用于射击，后来开发团队对其进行了调整，使得玩家能够以更细腻的方式用扳机键与世界交互，而不是直接就掏出武器。现在，这套系统，以及 Rockstar 在这方面的经验积累，都被带到了《GTA 6》中。
他介绍道：“我们在设计、代码行为、动画和文本编写上面投入了大量的心血。
“这才让这些互动显得真实可信。在某种程度上，现在各个团队的所有成员 —— 无论是技术团队、动画团队、设计团队还是编剧团队 —— 都必须成为人类行为学研究者。他们会开始留意现实世界里的人是怎么行动的，会观察当你从两个人身边经过时，他们对话时的语调会发生什么样的变化。”
《GTA》式犯罪学
这种丰富的细节，以及由此带来的游戏体验，也离不开“罪犯档案”（Criminal Profile）这个新系统的支撑。
简而言之，“罪犯档案”就是《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》荣誉值系统的精神续作。玩家在游戏内的种种行为会对“罪犯档案”产生影响。尽管这些行为的确会被大致归类成“善”或者“恶”，但它的目的并不是鼓励玩家当一个循规蹈矩的三好市民。这毕竟还是一个关于犯罪的游戏，但具体要把事情做到多么恶劣的程度，就取决于玩家自己了。
Nelson 说：“在设计游戏时，我们会尽量为玩家提供选择。如果你想把事情闹大，你当然可以这么做，但如果你不想激化矛盾，也可以尽量去避免。但也不是总能成功。在我看来，这可以很好地服务叙事。
“这是一个关于一对亡命鸳鸯的故事。只要有可能，我们会尽量让系统和设计服务于这个叙事。比如说，如果在开车撞人、犯罪或者遇上其他麻烦之后选择逃跑，在警察赶来之前就逃之夭夭，而没有掏枪打人，没有激化矛盾，那么你通常不会惹上大麻烦 —— 当然，如果你想要把事情搞大，也完全可以。”
Nelson 表示，Rockstar 团队在《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》时期就开始尝试一个概念，即“玩家不是游戏中唯一的危险分子”。在不知法纪为何物的边疆地带，你可能会遭到流窜帮派的袭击，也可能会在小路上和他人大打出手。而《GTA 6》为这些选择再度添加了新的层次。
Nelson 说：“如果你在做主线让你做的事情，或者是正在抢劫，或者是其他人主动找你茬，这时候诉诸武力不会有什么问题。只有不停做出超出必要范围的行为，或者不停做完全没必要的行为时，你的档案才会向着某个方向倾斜。
“作为玩家，你有可能会在意这件事，也可能完全不在乎。本作没有所谓‘正确’或者‘错误’的游玩方式。
“在我们看来，这是一个很有趣的概念。在过往的游戏中，除了警察之外，与游戏世界里的其他角色相比，玩家的战斗力非常 OP，这当然也很有意思，但我觉得，这还是不如一个其他人也会产生冲动并主动出手的世界有趣。玩家依然很强大，但你不再是唯一可以运用暴力、唯一拥有武器或者唯一可以发疯的人。这让整个世界显得更加不可预测，也更加有趣。”
通缉与被捕
罪犯档案系统将与《GTA》系列经典的通缉系统并存。通缉系统现在加入了更多的机制，但那种甩掉警用直升机、开着跑车疯狂逃离、星星越来越多的刺激体验，依然原汁原味。
Nelson 介绍说：“只有在犯罪行为遭到他人目击，或者是触发了警报的情况下，《GTA 6》的通缉系统才会去通知警方。一星通缉不难摆脱。你可以从画面里的这些小图标看到，警方知道我们开的是什么车，所以我们最好弃车。他们还知道要找的是一对情侣。所以分头行动有助于降低警方的关注度。”
在逃跑的过程中更换座驾，或者是换身衣服、戴上一定棒球帽，也同样能够迷惑警方。不过，逃脱的关键有时候并不是一辆好车：在雷奥奈达州人口稠密的区域里，道路往往十分拥堵，这时候选择徒步逃跑反而更加明智。
“在移动手段方面，我们下了很多功夫，力求让一切动作都流畅丝滑，从而鼓励玩家选择这种下车狂奔、翻越围栏的玩法。如果在市区内达到了三星，开车逃跑可能会有些麻烦，除非是一辆很快的车或者是运动摩托。在更多的情况下，最好的选择是离开街道，下车钻进小巷子里。”
哥们，车不错啊
在《GTA 6》里，一个惹祸上身的好办法，就是点游戏的题，去偷辆车开。在实机演示中，我们看到的一幕是潜入警察局的车辆扣押场，并偷走委托人指定的一辆跑车。这是一辆价值不菲的车，Nelson 也借机介绍了《GTA 6》偷车流程上的改动。
他介绍说：“我们给车辆设定了一些层级。在以前，不管是什么车，玩家只要按下三角键就能把车打着，然后直接开走。我们觉得这浪费了很多玩法上的可能性，特别是在成长和决策方面。在本作前期，某些停在路边的车是没法偷的，只有推进主线并拿到了专用工具才行。不过，玩家依然可以抢有司机的车辆。”
此外，现在手机里还加了一个扫描器功能。在演示中，我们看到这个功能源于一个名叫“Waink”的 App，这谐音梗名字只能说懂的都懂。用 Waink 扫描车辆后可以看到一系列的信息。
Nelson 介绍说：“例如，它会告诉我这辆车上锁了，有警报，但没有防盗追踪器。它还会告诉我把这辆车卖给 Pay n’ Spray 喷漆店，或者专门收赃车的商家能卖多少钱，以及把它登记到自己名下要花多少钱。
“它也会让我知道，比如说，这辆车得用钥匙复制器才能偷。而另外一辆则需要 Slim Jim（一种细长金属条状的撬车工具）。所以我们给这个曾经一键完成的流程加了不少有趣的小工具，或者说需要操作的机制。”
多项选择
最终，你的游戏体验还是取决于你的选择。Rockstar 打造了一段感情、一段物语，以及一个丰富多彩且富有沉浸感的世界，但是要如何体验这一切，最终还是由玩家自己决定。
Nelson 说：“我们一直在努力寻找自由度与叙事性之间的平衡点。这是一份挑战，有时候，为了呈现一个足够有吸引力的故事，其他方面确实需要给叙事让位 —— 至少是在我们这里。为了让故事以令人信服的方式推进，就必须设置关键的情节点，所以在这种情况下，我们需要对玩家的游戏体验进行一些引导。但在本作中，我们会在不牺牲体验质量的前提下，尽可能为玩家提供自由度。”
当然，这也就意味着事情不可能永远按照计划发展，无论是 11 月开玩的玩家，还是 Nelson 自己，都会遇到很多出人意料的状况 —— 比如在演示期间，Nelson 在躲避追捕时被侧面驶来的汽车创飞，直接当场 Wasted。
Nelson 说：“开放世界中的很多东西都让我们感到非常兴奋，无论是开放世界对玩家作出的反馈，还是各个系统之间的配合。当玩家在开放世界里漫游时，经常会遇到非常自然的‘涌现式’体验。
“刚才那一下就是我完全没有预料到的‘涌现式’体验，在我们开过那个停车场时，杰森提议我们去干那个活儿 —— 我以前都没听过他说这句台词呢。而这也起了效果 —— 我原本打算去当铺，但听杰森这么说，我就改了主意。”
他接着道：“《GTA 6》最酷的地方之一，就是和搭档一起行动有多么有趣。你肯定已经在（分量十足的一瞥预告片）里看到过了，我很期待玩家们能否感觉到这一点。
“视频里展示了三个有不少动作场面的任务，中间还穿插了大量的玩法展示，但在其中一个小片段里，我们展示了几场双人组队抢劫，这体现了在主线任务之余，你还可以在这个世界里体验到大量丰富的内容。”
是心动的感觉
双人组队行动是《GTA 6》带来的另外一个大变化。虽然《GTA》早就有了在多名主角之间进行切换的机制，但这一次，你不仅可以在杰森和露西娅之间自由切换，还能让他们作为一个集体一起行动，顺便培养他们的感情。
Nelson 说：“游戏中有一个用来记录你是什么样的罪犯的系统。此外还有一个关系系统。两者是分开的。经营这段关系的方式和现实世界中维系感情的方式差不多 —— 陪伴。
“在开放世界中一起探索，一起活动，一起打台球、打迷你高尔夫、划皮划艇等等，一起享受平淡的日常。当然，也可以一起抢商店、抢银行。无论选择何种方式，共度时光都可以对两人的关系产生积极影响。”
当你一个人在开放世界里闯荡时，你可以通过短信与另一半保持联系，比如道声晚安，或者约对方出来见面。听 Nelson 的说法，本作依然会有《GTA》式的狗血展开，但在其核心是一段很真实的人物关系。
Nelson 提醒说：“在故事的一开头，对于这段感情，杰森和露西娅都是抱着试一试的态度。如果仅仅是一起推主线、做任务，可能并不足以维系他们的感情。只有在开放世界里花时间陪伴彼此，才能真正巩固他们的关系，也让玩家更加在乎他们的故事。”
尽管杰森和露西娅的感情关系从剧情层面延伸到了《GTA 6》的系统机制中，但 Nelson 强调说，即便玩家不想经营这段感情，也不会对游戏体验产生负面影响。
Nelson 解释说：“本作的叙事结构决定了，在剧情的大部分时间里，他们都必须互相配合，一起行动。即便在关系最差的情况下，他们也会以犯罪搭档的关系一起完成大部分剧情。我不想透露太多，以免不小心剧透。但这为剧情增添了一个很吸引人的元素，这也是我们想要尝试这种故事的原因之一，因为对我们来说，这是一种全新的尝试。
“如果玩家对这方面感兴趣，我们能否让《GTA》提供某种情感共鸣？而如果玩家不感兴趣，我们能否提供相应的机制？如果玩家觉得‘我不想在这个游戏里谈恋爱’，我们该怎么做？这正是我们想要弄清楚的。我们绝对不想把它强加给玩家。”
在双主角的情况下，玩家势必会更加偏爱其中一人 —— 我个人很喜欢飒爽的露西娅，但你可能会更加喜欢杰森那种“拿着枪的金毛犬”的气质 —— 不过为了避免在角色塑造上厚此薄彼，Rockstar 可谓煞费苦心。
Nelson 告诉我：“随着故事的展开，我们非常有意识地确保每个角色都能得到足够多的时间。在做完《GTA 5》之后，我们探讨过很多想法 —— 要不要做更多主角？在做了三个主角之后，下一步该怎么走？变成四个主角吗？但这样会稀释每个角色的时间，进而削弱玩家对每个角色的感情。于是，我们最终选择了一对处于恋爱关系中的双主角。
“但紧接着又出现了一个新的问题：要怎么让玩家觉得，‘两个角色我都很喜欢？’在所有的文娱作品中，‘化学反应’都是个很难把握的东西。在角色和演员之间，化学反应这东西要么是有，要么就是没有。
“所有人都为此而投入了大量精力。我认为我们最终做出了化学反应。从我们团队内部的反馈来看，他们无论是作为独立的角色，还是作为一对情侣，效果都很好。”
终点在望
在我采访 Nelson 时，距离“分量十足的一瞥”预告片上线还有一个月的时间，这段加长预告片展示了迄今为止最为丰富的情报，所以我忍不住问他，Rockstar 希望粉丝们会有什么样的反应？在让粉丝们翘首以盼了这么长时间之后，开发团队又承受了多大的压力？
Nelson 回答说：“我尽量不去想这些。我们当然知道那份期待。但我觉得，我们能做的就是专注于游戏本身，在过往游戏的基础上进行创新，实现进化，同时也保留大家熟悉的味道。
“尽管外界压力很大，但还是比不上我们团队自己给自己上的压力。所有人都力臻完美。我们都很紧张！紧张是必然的，但我们也很兴奋，很期待大家对这段视频的反应，以及大家最终对游戏本身的反应。
“对我们来说，这绝对是一次全方位的进步 —— 不管是世界的体量，还是它的深度。在进入游戏，看到那密集的车流、密集的人群，以及他们对你作出的极为真实的反应时，是会感到一些震撼的。”
这也正是我此行最大的感想：玩家绝对会被震撼到。那种震撼，就像是发现自己的宠物狗狗能预测彩票中奖号码，或者突然发现自己是一位布达佩斯已故富豪的继承人。尽管 Nelson 说这依然是一款“地地道道的《GTA》”，但我见到的所有这些新内容和新细节，已经足以让《GTA 6》成为开放世界游戏的全新标杆。
Nelson 说，“《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》里就像是藏着一整个世界，而《GTA 6》也是如此。玩家会在游戏中发现很多涌现式的体验，它们没有任务目标或者地图标记，并非由系统专门引导着玩家去体验，而是在机缘巧合下诞生。只要你花些时间探索，就一定会有收获，而且是很丰厚的收获。”
《GTA 6》将于 11 月 19 日发售。
